title: hemionitis pilifera
intro: Hemionitis pilifera, commonly known as the Japanese chain fern or Limestone fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Japan and China, for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis pilifera are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
